description: Select and make available the complete evidence and resource procedure required by the current capability path. This behavior handles invocation dependencies; package-wide build parity and conformance assessment remain separate.
inputs: Prepared invocation, current path conditions, and any newly discovered triggers.
Resource map, specialist evidence contract, available project evidence, and packaged resources.
outputs: Selected complete procedure and output resources with their applicability, ownership, and use conditions.
Explicit missing, inconsistent, or unsafe required resource and stopped dependent scope.
behavior: Distinguish project evidence from packaged resources and evaluate each declared load/use condition, including transitive obligations.
Make selected content readable, contained, current, and consistent before dependent use; do not require untriggered resources at runtime.
Preserve COPY/assets, READ/references, and RUN/scripts meaning and expose script inputs, results, and failure actions under the existing package contract.
Use scoped evidence when sufficient, obtaining complete subjects when the judgment or behavior-changing decision requires them; keep material omitted detail obtainable.
On a late trigger, select the additional complete procedure before dependent action rather than inferring it from examples or memory.
Allow only a disclosed redundant-convenience fallback when the entire needed contract is already loaded; keep invocation success separate from package integrity.

For the adopted requirement-first workflow, resolve distinct requirement, logical-design, architectural-design and review methods from one canonical version. Refuse mixed old proposal-first and replacement handoffs on a dependent path.

failure_behavior.condition: Required normative content, output structure, or a transitive resource is missing, escaped, stale, inconsistent, or incompatible.
failure_behavior.outcome: Identify the missing dependency and stop the affected work without inventing procedure.
Do not block unrelated portable work solely for that absence; do not certify the package as valid.
